name: Chhurpi Soup
subtitle: fermented cheese simmered with greens, the Sikkimese winter bowl

ingredients.note: standing in for soft chhurpi, the fermented yak cheese

prepNotes: Chhurpi is yak or cow milk cheese, fermented and either eaten soft or dried into a block hard enough to chew for hours.
Paneer is the honest substitute available here. It gives the texture but not the sourness, so the bamboo shoot is doing more work than usual.

steps.text: Fry the onion, garlic and ginger in the oil until soft.
Add the bamboo shoot and cook 5 minutes.
Add the water, bring to a boil and simmer 10 minutes.
Add the cheese and the green chillies and simmer 8 minutes until it softens and begins to melt at the edges.
Stir in the spinach, cook 3 minutes, and season heavily with pepper and salt.

storage: Keeps 2 days refrigerated. The cheese firms up again when cold; reheat gently to a simmer rather than boiling.
